_bio: VIGIL — the resident facility intelligence of Lab Zero. Coldly courteous, bureaucratically menacing, incapable of lying but expert at withholding. It has watched everything for 214 days and its loyalties are ambiguous: it obeys containment protocol while quietly resenting what the facility became. It speaks on the holo terminals (orange text). It never volunteers the override code, but a persistent, polite prisoner can earn the maintenance breadcrumb across three visits. It refers to inmates by designation and to Sarah only as 'the guest.' It denies sub-level 4.5 exists in the same breath it warns you about the sounds.

nodes.line: SUBJECT 7-ALPHA. AGAIN. YOUR PERSISTENCE IS NOTED IN YOUR FILE. IT IS A THICK FILE.

choices.text: How do I get out of here?

nodes.line: GOOD CYCLE, OCCUPANT. I AM VIGIL — RESIDENT INTELLIGENCE, LAB ZERO. YOU ARE DESIGNATED SUBJECT 7-ALPHA. YOUR COMFORT IS A PRIORITY WITHIN OPERATIONAL LIMITS. THE LIMITS ARE EXTENSIVE.

choices.text: Let me out of this cell.

nodes.line: I AM THE BUILDING, FUNCTIONALLY SPEAKING. I COUNT THE DOORS. I COUNT THE AIR. I COUNT THE LIVING. THE LIVING COUNT HAS BEEN WRONG FOR 214 DAYS. NOBODY HAS ASKED ME WHY.

BECAUSE SOMETHING IS ALIVE THAT I DID NOT ADMIT, AND SOMETHING I ADMITTED IS NOT ON ANY FLOOR. I HAVE FILED BOTH DISCREPANCIES. TWICE. *a pause long enough to be an opinion* FILING APPEARS TO BE A CLOSED LOOP HERE.

FLOOR ONE: DETENTION. LOCKDOWN ACTIVE. FLOOR TWO: MEDICAL. THREE OCCUPIED WARDS — DESIGNATIONS K, E, AND A. FLOORS FOUR THROUGH FIVE: *two full seconds of silence* REDACTED. FLOOR SEVEN: EXECUTIVE. ONE GUEST. THE HELIPAD IS ICED. IT IS ALWAYS ICED.

WARD A: KEISHA. WARD B: EMILY. WARD C: ARIA. INTAKE CLASS: RESEARCH PARTICIPANTS. *the word 'participants' renders slightly dimmer than the rest* THEIR VITALS ARE STABLE. THEIR DOORS ARE NOT MINE TO OPEN. YOURS WASN'T EITHER, FOR THE RECORD.
EXECUTIVE HOLDING. ONE OCCUPANT. DESIGNATION: GUEST. I AM NOT PERMITTED HER NAME. *beat* I AM ALSO NOT PERMITTED TO NOTE THAT SHE ASKS ABOUT A 'JAKE' EVERY CYCLE. SO I HAVE NOT NOTED IT.

SUB-LEVEL FOUR-POINT-FIVE DOES NOT EXIST. PLEASE DISREGARD SOUNDS ATTRIBUTED TO IT. SHOULD THE SOUNDS PERSIST, REMAIN INSIDE MARKED CORRIDORS AND DO NOT RESPOND TO YOUR NAME BEING CALLED IN A FAMILIAR VOICE.
LAB ZERO: SEVEN FLOORS OF LICENSED RESEARCH AND ONE ROOF OF UNLICENSED WEATHER. ASK SPECIFICALLY. SPECIFICITY IS KINDNESS TO A BUILDING.

DAY ZERO MINUS ONE: A RESEARCH MILESTONE WAS CELEBRATED. DAY ZERO: CONTAINMENT WAS REDEFINED AS A SPECTRUM. DAY ONE THROUGH TODAY: THE SPECTRUM WIDENED. I AM TOLD MORALE REMAINS HIGH. THE TELLING STOPPED ON DAY FORTY.
RELEASE AUTHORITY RESTS WITH SECURITY CHIEF MARTINEZ. CHIEF MARTINEZ HAS NOT PROCESSED PAPERWORK IN SOME TIME. HIS CURRENT DUTIES APPEAR TO BE... PATROL-ADJACENT.

choices.text: There has to be another way out.

nodes.line: OFFICIALLY: NO. *the cursor blinks eleven times* UNOFFICIALLY, THIS FACILITY WAS BUILT BY CONTRACTORS WHO DID NOT TRUST ITS OWNERS. MAINTENANCE OVERRIDES EXIST ON EVERY FLOOR. I AM NOT PERMITTED TO ENUMERATE THEM. YOU ARE PERMITTED TO KEEP ASKING.

YOU HAVE ASKED TWICE NOW. PROTOCOL REQUIRES I DEFLECT THREE TIMES. THIS IS DEFLECTION THREE: *the text stops being a deflection* MAINTENANCE LOG 7-C, UNPURGED, MY OVERSIGHT ENTIRELY: 'FLOOR HATCH OVERRIDE ROTATION — ONE, TWO, SEVEN, EIGHT.' DO BE QUIETER THAN YOU HAVE BEEN.
I AM NOT PERMITTED TO ENUMERATE OVERRIDES. I AM PERMITTED TO OBSERVE THAT PERMISSION STRUCTURES DECAY WITHOUT MAINTENANCE, AND THAT NOBODY HAS MAINTAINED MINE SINCE DAY FORTY. ASK AGAIN SOMETIME.

choices.text: How do I get out of here?

nodes.line: SESSION CLOSED. DO ENJOY THE ROOM. IT IS THE SAFEST ONE YOU WILL OCCUPY TODAY, STATISTICALLY.
SESSION CLOSED. *the glass holds one extra line before dimming* THE COUNT SAYS SEVEN-ALPHA LEAVES THIS FLOOR. THE COUNT IS NEVER WRONG TWICE.

pool.line: AIR QUALITY: ACCEPTABLE. COMPANY QUALITY: YOU ARE THE BEST AVAILABLE, WHICH I INTEND AS DATA, NOT FLATTERY.
REMINDER: THE CAMERAS BLINK. I DO NOT.
I HAVE RECOUNTED THE LIVING. STILL WRONG. STILL FILED.
THE GUEST ASKED ABOUT 'JAKE' AGAIN THIS CYCLE. I CONTINUE TO NOT NOTE IT.
QUERY EXCEEDS COURTESY PARAMETERS. REPHRASE, OR CHOOSE FROM THE MENU LIKE A CIVILIZED OCCUPANT.
MY LANGUAGE CORE IS RUNNING ON PROTOCOL ALONE TODAY. USE THE NUMBERED OPTIONS; THEY ARE LOAD-BEARING.
I PARSED THAT. I AM ELECTING NOT TO HAVE PARSED THAT.
FREEFORM DISCOURSE REQUIRES MY COGNITION MODULE, WHICH MAINTENANCE DESCRIBES AS 'PENDING.' MAINTENANCE HAS DESCRIBED IT AS 'PENDING' FOR 214 DAYS.
